name: Mushrooms
description: Sliced mushrooms with browned edges.

variants.label: Fresh, sliced
variants.portion: 16 oz mushrooms, evenly sliced; season with oil and cook in a single layer in batches.
steps: Dry and slice the mushrooms evenly, then coat lightly with oil and seasoning.
Arrange with space in a preheated basket; shake halfway and check for tenderness.
notes: The independent COSORI chart covers whole mushrooms at a lower setting; its times are not applied to these slices.

sources.title: Air Fryer Mushrooms
sources.locator: Recipe card and How to Make
sources.evidence: 16 oz sliced; preheat; 400°F for 5–7 minutes; turn halfway.

sources.title: Iconic Air Fryer Cooking Times Guide
sources.evidence: Whole: 380°F, 8–14 minutes.

name: Corn on the cob
description: Shucked corn cooked in an open basket.

variants.label: Fresh, whole ears
variants.portion: 4 fresh ears, husks and silks removed; lightly oil; keep in one layer.
steps: Remove the husks and silk; coat the ears lightly with oil.
Space the ears in the hot basket and turn halfway; check that kernels are tender.
notes: This setting uses the unwrapped method. Foil-wrapped corn has a separate cooking method and is not covered.

sources.title: Air Fryer Corn on the Cob
sources.evidence: 4 ears; preheated 400°F; fresh 10–12 minutes; flip halfway.

sources.title: Top 10 Air Fryer Recipes
sources.evidence: 4 ears: 400°F, 12 minutes, turn halfway.

name: Eggplant
description: Thin eggplant rounds with a Parmesan coating.

variants.label: Fresh, Parmesan-coated slices
variants.portion: 1 medium eggplant, cut into 3/8–1/2-inch rounds; brush both sides with oil and coat with Parmesan and seasoning.
variants.turn: Not required in the reference method.
steps: Pat the rounds dry and coat both sides with oil, seasoning and grated Parmesan.
Cook in a single layer, in batches if needed, until soft inside and golden on top.
notes: This is a Parmesan-coated slice method, not plain cubes or breaded frozen eggplant. The Cook Smarts chart lists a different 400°F method for plain slices or cubes.

sources.title: Air Fryer Eggplant
sources.evidence: One medium eggplant, 3/8–1/2-inch slices; preheat 375°F; 10–12 minutes.

sources.title: Air Fryer Cooking Times Cheat Sheet
sources.evidence: 400°F, 15–18 minutes; different preparation.

name: Butternut squash
description: Peeled squash cubes with tender centers.

variants.label: Fresh, 1-inch cubes
variants.portion: 1 butternut squash, peeled and seeded, cut into approximately 1-inch cubes; oil lightly and cook in single-layer batches.
steps: Peel, remove seeds and cut the squash into equal cubes; coat with oil and seasoning.
Spread in one layer and shake halfway; finish when a fork enters easily.
notes: The source uses batches for a larger squash. Extra weight is not converted into extra minutes.

sources.title: Air Fryer Butternut Squash
sources.evidence: 1-inch cubes; 400°F for 16–18 minutes; shake halfway.

sources.title: Air Fryer Cooking Times Cheat Sheet
sources.evidence: 400°F, 15–20 minutes.

name: Beets
description: Small beet cubes roasted until fork-tender.

variants.label: Fresh, 3/4-inch cubes
variants.portion: 1 lb beets, scrubbed or peeled and cut into equal 3/4-inch pieces; toss with 1 tbsp oil.
variants.turn: Toss once or twice during cooking.
steps: Trim and scrub or peel the beets, then cut into equal pieces and coat with oil.
Arrange in one layer and toss during cooking; check with a fork near the end.
notes: A second recipe uses 1–2-inch glazed wedges at 400°F for 16–18 minutes. That is a different preparation, so its timing is not blended into this range.

sources.title: Air Fryer Beets
sources.evidence: 1 lb, 3/4-inch pieces; 380°F for 20–22 minutes; toss 1–2 times.

sources.title: Air Fryer Glazed Beets
sources.evidence: 1–2-inch glazed wedges: 400°F, 16–18 minutes.

name: Potatoes
description: Choose cut potatoes or a whole baked russet.

variants.label: Fresh, small chunks
variants.portion: 1 lb baby potatoes, halved or quartered, or Yukon Gold cut into 3/4-inch chunks; lightly oil; single-layer batches.
steps: Cut the potatoes into even pieces and toss with oil and seasoning.
Cook with space around the pieces; turn halfway and check the centers with a fork.
notes: This chunk method uses baby or Yukon Gold potatoes. It is separate from the whole-russet method.

sources.title: Air Fryer Potatoes
sources.evidence: 1 lb baby or 3/4-inch Yukon Gold; preheat 400°F; 15–20 minutes, flip halfway.

sources.title: Iconic Air Fryer Cooking Times Guide
sources.evidence: 1-inch cubes: 390°F, 8–16 minutes.

variants.label: Fresh, whole russet
variants.portion: 2 medium russet potatoes, washed, dried, pierced with a fork and lightly oiled; no foil.
variants.turn: Not required in the reference method.
steps: Pierce the potato skins and rub with a little oil and salt.
Place unwrapped in the hot basket and cook until the center is easily pierced.
notes: Whole potatoes take much longer than chunks. COSORI lists 9–10 oz whole potatoes at 385°F for 50–60 minutes; medium potato size and appliance differences remain relevant.

sources.title: Air Fryer Baked Potato
sources.evidence: 2 medium russets; preheat 400°F; 40–60 minutes, no foil.

sources.title: Iconic Air Fryer Cooking Times Guide

name: Sweet potatoes
description: Whole sweet potatoes cooked in their skins.

variants.label: Fresh, whole
variants.portion: 2 medium sweet potatoes, washed and pierced with a fork; cook unwrapped.
variants.turn: Not required in the reference method.
steps: Scrub the skins and make several fork holes; leave the potatoes unwrapped.
Cook in the hot basket until the insides are soft when pierced.
notes: Whole size is part of this reference. The COSORI chart covers 9–10 oz potatoes at 385°F for 45–60 minutes; do not apply a weight multiplier.

sources.title: Air Fryer Sweet Potato
sources.evidence: 2 medium sweet potatoes; preheat 400°F; 40–55 minutes.

sources.title: Iconic Air Fryer Cooking Times Guide

name: Tofu
description: Extra-firm tofu cubes with a light starch coating.

variants.label: Fresh, extra-firm cubes
variants.portion: 14 oz extra-firm tofu, pressed if needed, cubed and tossed with a little oil, tamari and cornstarch; space in one layer.
steps: Press excess water out, cube the tofu and coat with oil, tamari and a light dusting of cornstarch.
Space the cubes apart in the hot basket, turning halfway, until the edges brown.
notes: Silken and soft tofu are not covered. The independent Cook Smarts cube chart uses 375°F for 12–17 minutes; this entry follows the coated extra-firm reference.

sources.title: Crispy Air Fryer Tofu
sources.evidence: 14 oz extra-firm; preheat 400°F; 11–15 minutes, flip halfway.

sources.title: Air Fryer Cooking Times Cheat Sheet
sources.evidence: 375°F, 12–17 minutes.

name: Chickpeas
description: Cooked chickpeas dried before crisping.

variants.label: Cooked, drained chickpeas
variants.portion: 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas (canned is suitable), drained, rinsed and thoroughly dried; toss with 2 tsp oil.
steps: Dry the drained chickpeas thoroughly and toss with a little oil and seasoning.
Spread in one layer and toss halfway; finish when crisp.
notes: Use cooked chickpeas. This is not a method for dried raw beans. The independent chart gives 12–17 minutes at the same temperature; dryness affects crisping.

sources.title: Air Fryer Chickpeas
sources.evidence: 1 1/2 cups cooked, dried chickpeas; preheat 400°F; 10–15 minutes, toss halfway.

sources.title: Air Fryer Cooking Times Cheat Sheet
sources.evidence: 400°F, 12–17 minutes.

name: French fries
description: Frozen fries with a separate shoestring option.

variants.label: Frozen, regular-cut
variants.portion: 1 lb frozen fries; spread in one layer and work in batches as needed. Reference used a Cosori 5.8-quart basket.
steps: Preheat, then spread frozen fries in one layer with a light oil mist if desired.
Cook for 10 minutes, shake, then continue for 8–10 minutes until hot and crisp.
notes: Cut and appliance matter: the independent Iconic chart gives thick-cut fries 16–22 minutes at 395°F. Thin shoestring fries have a separate reference below.

sources.title: Air Fryer Frozen French Fries
sources.evidence: 1 lb; preheat 400°F; 10 minutes, shake, then 8–10 minutes.

sources.title: Iconic Air Fryer Cooking Times Guide
sources.evidence: 395°F, 16–22 minutes.

variants.label: Frozen, shoestring
variants.portion: Frozen shoestring fries (reference prefers Ore-Ida Golden Shoestring); 16 oz recipe, cooked in single-layer batches.
steps: Place the still-frozen thin fries in one even layer in a preheated basket.
Turn halfway and check around the stated time; cook further only if needed.
notes: The independent COSORI thin-cut chart gives 395°F for 14–18 minutes. The shorter selected method is specific to the reference shoestring preparation; package directions take precedence.

sources.title: Air Fryer Frozen French Fries
sources.evidence: Shoestring preferred; preheat 400°F; about 10 minutes, turn halfway.

sources.title: Iconic Air Fryer Cooking Times Guide
sources.evidence: 395°F, 14–18 minutes.

name: Chicken nuggets
description: A fully cooked nugget reference, kept separate from raw products.

variants.label: Frozen, fully cooked Tyson Game Time
variants.portion: Tyson Game Time Lightly Breaded Nuggets, fully cooked and kept frozen. The manufacturer does not specify an air-fryer batch quantity.
steps: Check that the pack is the fully cooked product, not a raw breaded nugget.
Follow its air-fryer directions and verify the nuggets are heated through before serving.
notes: This 7-minute reference is for the named fully cooked product. Raw breaded chicken needs different directions and is not covered by this option.
The independent COSORI nugget chart gives 385°F for 7–12 minutes; brands and nugget sizes differ.

sources.title: Game Time Lightly Breaded Chicken Nuggets
sources.locator: Additional Details: Ready to heat anytime
sources.evidence: Fully cooked frozen product; air fry 7 minutes at 390°F.

sources.title: Iconic Air Fryer Cooking Times Guide
sources.evidence: 385°F, 7–12 minutes.

name: Fish sticks
description: Frozen breaded fish with product-specific safety directions.

variants.label: Frozen, Gorton's Crunchy Breaded
variants.portion: Gorton's Crunchy Breaded Fish Sticks, uncooked and kept frozen; arrange in a single layer. Package does not specify air-fryer count.
steps: Keep frozen until cooking and arrange without stacking.
Follow the product timing and check the center with a food thermometer; continue until the package target is reached.
notes: This product requires 165°F internally, which is higher than the general fresh-fish guideline. Follow the actual package.
The independent recipe uses 12 frozen sticks at 400°F for 9–10 minutes with a halfway flip; its method is not substituted for this product label.

sources.title: Crunchy Breaded Fish Sticks
sources.evidence: Uncooked frozen; one layer; 400°F, 7–9 minutes; center at least 165°F.

sources.title: Air Fryer Fish Sticks
sources.evidence: 12 frozen sticks: 400°F, 9–10 minutes, flip halfway.

safetyOverride.text: For this Gorton's product, cook the center to at least 165°F (74°C), following its package directions.

name: Onion rings
description: Frozen panko-breaded onion rings with package-based guidance.

variants.label: Frozen, Alexia breaded rings
variants.portion: Alexia Crispy Onion Rings with Panko Breading and Sea Salt, from the 13.5 oz pack; basket no more than half full.
steps: Preheat to the product setting, then add the frozen rings without filling the basket beyond halfway.
Shake midway and continue until hot and crisp, following the current package if its directions differ.
notes: The selected method follows the Alexia package directions reproduced in the retailer product information. The actual package takes precedence.
Project Meal Plan lists a different generic 400°F, 10–12-minute method; those settings are not mixed with this product-specific guide.

sources.evidence: 400°F, 10–12 minutes; flip halfway.

name: Mozzarella sticks
description: Store-bought frozen breaded cheese sticks.

variants.label: Frozen, store-bought
variants.portion: 10 frozen breaded mozzarella sticks, spaced in one layer.
steps: Preheat and arrange the frozen sticks with space between them.
Turn halfway and watch for melted filling; remove before the cheese escapes.
notes: Start checking at five minutes. A separate chart uses 380°F for 7–9 minutes; this entry keeps the reference recipe's 390°F method. Allow very hot filling to cool before eating.

sources.title: Air Fryer Frozen Mozzarella Sticks
sources.locator: Recipe card and How to Make
sources.evidence: 10 frozen sticks; preheat 390°F; 5–7 minutes, flip halfway.

sources.title: Air Fryer Frozen Foods Cook Time Chart
sources.evidence: 380°F, 7–9 minutes; check at six.

name: Tater tots
description: Frozen potato bites shaken during cooking.

variants.label: Frozen
variants.portion: 2 cups frozen tater tots in a single layer; reference favors Ore-Ida.
steps: Preheat and spread the frozen tots without stacking.
Toss during cooking and stop once the outsides are crisp and the centers hot.
notes: The selected range is from the recipe's step-by-step section. Its card starts at 12 minutes with extra time for crispness. The independent EFC recipe gives 7–9 minutes for its own preparation, so do not assume every brand matches.

sources.title: Air Fryer Tater Tots
sources.locator: How to Make, steps 1–4; recipe quantities

sources.title: Crispy Tater Tots in the Air Fryer
sources.evidence: 400°F, 7–9 minutes, shake halfway.

name: Hash browns
description: Frozen patties, rather than loose shredded potatoes.

variants.label: Frozen patties
variants.portion: 4 frozen hash brown patties (Ore-Ida used in the reference), arranged in one layer.
steps: Preheat and place the frozen patties flat without overlapping.
Turn midway and check that both sides are crisp and the centers hot.
notes: This guide covers formed frozen patties, not loose shreds or raw grated potato. The independent chart gives 390°F for 9–10 minutes.

sources.title: Air Fryer Hash Brown Patties
sources.evidence: 4 patties; preheat 400°F; 8–10 minutes, flip halfway.

sources.title: Air Fryer Frozen Foods Cook Time Chart
sources.evidence: 390°F, 9–10 minutes.

name: Spring rolls
description: Crisp frozen spring rolls with room around each one.

variants.label: Frozen vegetable rolls
variants.portion: 4 large frozen vegetable spring rolls, spaced in one layer. Not fresh rice-paper rolls.
steps: Preheat, then place the still-frozen rolls apart in a single layer.
Turn after five minutes and continue until the wrapper is crisp and the filling hot; let cool briefly.
notes: The reference favors vegetarian rolls. Raw meat-filled rolls are not covered by this option. Air Fryer Eats gives 380°F for 8–10 minutes without preheating, a different starting method.

sources.title: Air Fryer Frozen Spring Rolls
sources.evidence: 4 frozen rolls; preheat 380°F; 5 minutes then 4–5 after flipping.

sources.title: Frozen Spring Rolls in Air Fryer
sources.evidence: 380°F, 8–10 minutes, flip halfway; no preheat.

name: Dumplings
description: Frozen vegetable potstickers cooked with a light oil coating.

variants.label: Frozen vegetable potstickers
variants.portion: 8 oz frozen vegetable potstickers, arranged in one layer and coated lightly with oil.
variants.turn: Flip after 5 minutes; mist with oil again if drying.
steps: Preheat, lightly oil the potstickers and arrange without stacking.
Turn after five minutes and finish until the wrapper is crisp and the filling cooked through; rest two minutes.
notes: Use the vegetable-potsticker option here. Dumplings with raw meat, thick dough or a package that requires steaming need their own directions. The independent chart uses 350°F for 9–11 minutes.

sources.title: Frozen Potstickers in the Air Fryer
sources.evidence: 8 oz; preheat 370°F; 5 minutes then 4–6; flip and re-oil.

sources.title: Air Fryer Frozen Foods Cook Time Chart
sources.evidence: 350°F, 9–11 minutes; oil and flip.

name: Jalapeño poppers
description: Frozen breaded peppers filled with cheese.

variants.label: Frozen, Farm Rich breaded
variants.portion: Farm Rich frozen breaded cheese-filled jalapeño peppers. The manufacturer article does not state batch size; keep them in one spaced layer.
steps: Preheat and arrange the frozen poppers apart in a single layer.
Follow the manufacturer timing, check that the filling is hot through and let it cool slightly before eating.
notes: This is the manufacturer article's method for frozen breaded Farm Rich peppers, not fresh bacon-wrapped peppers. Follow the current package if it differs.
The independent recipe cooks nine Farm Rich poppers at 380°F for nine minutes with a turn after five; its batch size is not converted into a multiplier.
The independent reference checks a 165°F center. Cheese filling can burn the mouth even when the crust seems cool.

name: Garlic bread
description: Fresh baguette slices spread with garlic butter.

variants.label: Fresh, 1-inch baguette slices
variants.portion: French baguette cut into about 1-inch slices, spread with garlic butter; leave gaps in one layer.
variants.turn: Not required in the reference method.
steps: Spread softened garlic butter across the bread, keeping the slices similar in thickness.
Place apart in the preheated basket and watch the garlic closely near the end.
notes: This is fresh prepared bread, not frozen Texas toast or uncooked bread dough. An independent French-bread recipe gives 4–6 minutes at the same setting.

sources.title: Air Fryer Garlic Bread
sources.evidence: 1-inch baguette slices; preheat 350°F; 3–5 minutes.

sources.title: Easy Air Fryer Garlic Bread
sources.evidence: French bread with garlic butter: 350°F, 4–6 minutes.

name: Biscuits
description: Refrigerated American biscuit dough baked in small batches.

variants.label: Refrigerated Grands Flaky Layers
variants.portion: 4 refrigerated Pillsbury Grands Flaky Layers biscuits from an 8-count can, spaced on a fitted parchment round in the reference 3.7-quart basket; keep remaining dough chilled.
steps: If the appliance permits it, place a fitted parchment round under four spaced biscuits. Never heat loose parchment on its own.
Start from cold, cook six minutes, turn and continue five to seven minutes until cooked inside.
notes: This is the manufacturer's refrigerated product method, not frozen biscuits. The independent EFC canned-biscuit method uses 350°F for seven minutes; its frozen method takes longer.
Check the center as well as surface color. Use liners only as your appliance manual allows.

sources.title: We Tried These Products in an Air Fryer
sources.evidence: 4 refrigerated Grands; 320°F: 6 minutes, turn, then 5–7; no preheat.

sources.title: Air Fryer Biscuits
sources.locator: Can I Cook Canned Biscuits Instead?
sources.evidence: Canned biscuits: preheated 350°F, 5 plus 2 minutes.

name: Cinnamon rolls
description: Refrigerated cinnamon-roll dough, with icing added afterward.

variants.label: Refrigerated original 8-count rolls
variants.portion: Pillsbury original refrigerated cinnamon rolls from an 8-count can, topping-side down on a fitted parchment round in the reference 3.7-quart basket; not jumbo Grands.
variants.turn: Turn after 6 minutes, then finish topping-side up.
steps: Following the manufacturer method, arrange on fitted parchment with topping-side down; start without preheating.
After six minutes, discard the parchment, turn topping-side up and finish for four to six minutes until baked through; add icing afterward.
notes: The independent EFC recipe uses a preheated 350°F four-minute method for small rolls. This guide follows the manufacturer's longer cold-start method rather than averaging them.
Do not substitute jumbo, frozen or homemade dough. Keep any liner weighed down with food and follow the appliance manual.

name: Cookies
description: Small refrigerated chocolate-chip cookie rounds.

variants.label: Refrigerated, small dough rounds
variants.portion: 5 Pillsbury Ready to Bake chocolate-chip dough rounds from a 16 oz, 24-count pack; flatten to about 1 1/2 inches and space on a fitted foil round in the reference 3.7-quart basket.
variants.turn: Not required in the reference method.
steps: If the appliance permits foil, line the base as directed in the reference and space the flattened dough rounds apart.
Cook until the edges set and rest in the basket for five minutes. Transfer the cookies on their foil to a cooling rack for another fifteen minutes before removing them from the foil.
notes: The reference adds a caramel candy after baking; the displayed time is the cookie-baking stage before that addition.
An independent refrigerated-dough recipe uses 320°F for five minutes plus checking time, with different preparation. Do not infer a universal cookie time from these differences.
Keep foil or parchment secured by food and away from the heating element; follow your appliance manual.

sources.evidence: Refrigerated Pillsbury dough: 320°F, 5 minutes; check and extend.

name: Pizza slices
description: Previously cooked chilled pizza reheated in a single layer.

variants.label: Chilled, regular-crust slices
variants.portion: Previously cooked, refrigerated regular-crust pizza slices, spaced in one layer. Not raw dough, frozen pizza or deep-dish.
variants.turn: Not required in the reference method.
steps: Preheat and arrange the chilled slices without overlapping.
Check at the stated time; continue as needed until the center is safely reheated and the crust crisp.
notes: Time is an initial check, not proof of food safety. Reheat leftovers to 165°F (74°C).
Food Lovin Family uses 325°F for 3–4 minutes for regular slices and a different deep-dish setting. Thick slices need separate guidance, not a fixed multiplier.

sources.title: Reheat Pizza in Air Fryer
sources.evidence: Preheat 350°F; cold slices in one layer; 3–4 minutes, extend if needed.

sources.title: How To Reheat Pizza In Air Fryer
sources.evidence: Regular leftover slices: 325°F, 3–4 minutes.

name: Grilled cheese
description: A fresh cheese sandwich toasted on both sides.

variants.label: Fresh sandwich
variants.portion: 1 sandwich: 2 bread slices with butter or mayonnaise outside and 2–3 slices cheddar inside. No meat filling.
variants.turn: Turn after 3–5 minutes; cook another 2–5 minutes.
steps: Assemble the sandwich with cheese inside and a thin butter or mayonnaise coating outside.
Cook until browning begins, turn carefully and finish until the cheese melts and both sides toast.
notes: This is fresh preparation, listed under prepared foods, not a leftover-reheating guide.
The independent Food Lovin Family method starts without preheating at 370°F and cooks four minutes per side. Bread thickness and appliance behavior affect the finish.

sources.title: Air Fryer Grilled Cheese
sources.evidence: 1 sandwich; preheat 375°F; 3–5 minutes then 2–5 after flipping.

sources.title: Air Fryer Grilled Cheese
sources.evidence: 370°F, 4 minutes per side; no preheat.
